uni:glossary.draw.label: Draw
uni:glossary.draw.description: Take one or more cards from the [k=uni:draw_pile]draw pile[/k] into your hand.
uni:glossary.skip.label: Skip
uni:glossary.skip.description: Causes the next player in [k=uni:turn]turn[/k] order to lose their turn.
uni:glossary.reverse.label: Reverse
uni:glossary.reverse.description: Reverses the direction of play. In a 2-player match, acts as a [k=uni:skip]skip[/k].
uni:glossary.wild.label: Wild
uni:glossary.wild.description: Can be played on any card. The player chooses the active [k=uni:color]color[/k].
uni:glossary.turn.label: Turn
uni:glossary.turn.description: A player's opportunity to [k=uni:play]play[/k] a valid card or [k=uni:draw]draw[/k].
uni:glossary.color.label: Color
uni:glossary.color.description: The active suit (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow) that determines valid plays.
uni:glossary.draw_pile.label: Draw Pile
uni:glossary.draw_pile.description: The central deck where players [k=uni:draw]draw[/k] cards when unable or choosing not to play.
uni:glossary.discard_pile.label: Discard Pile
uni:glossary.discard_pile.description: The pile where played cards are placed face-up.
uni:glossary.play.label: Play
uni:glossary.play.description: Place a matching card from your hand onto the [k=uni:discard_pile]discard pile[/k].
uni:glossary.seven_zero.label: 7-0 Rule
uni:glossary.seven_zero.description: Playing a 7 allows swapping hands with any player. Playing a 0 rotates all hands in [k=uni:turn]turn[/k] direction.
uni:glossary.draw_stacking.label: Draw Stacking
uni:glossary.draw_stacking.description: Stack +2 or +4 cards to pass the accumulated [k=uni:draw]draw[/k] penalty to the next player.
uni:glossary.force_play.label: Force Play
uni:glossary.force_play.description: When drawing a playable card from the deck, you must play it immediately.
uni:glossary.jump_in.label: Jump-In
uni:glossary.jump_in.description: Play out of turn if you have the exact identical card (same color and value) as the top card.
uni:glossary.progressive.label: Progressive
uni:glossary.progressive.description: Cards that match the top card's value can be chained together in the same [k=uni:turn]turn[/k].
uni:glossary.race.label: Race
uni:glossary.race.description: The first players to empty their hand win. The match ends once enough have finished, and everyone else loses.

uni:blue_reverse.description: [k=uni:reverse]Reverses[/k] the direction of [k=uni:play]play[/k]. In 2-player games, acts as a [k=uni:skip]skip[/k].
